scripts.setup:ptau: curl -fL -o ppot_0080_14.ptau https://pse-trusted-setup-ppot.s3.amazonaws.com/pot28_0080/ppot_0080_14.ptau && snarkjs powersoftau verify ppot_0080_14.ptau
scripts.setup:ceremony: snarkjs groth16 setup private-transfer.r1cs ppot_0080_14.ptau private-transfer_0000.zkey
scripts.setup:contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute private-transfer_0000.zkey private-transfer_0001.zkey --name='Obscura phase2 contribution' -e="$(head -c 64 /dev/urandom | xxd -p -c 64)"
scripts.setup:finalize: snarkjs zkey beacon private-transfer_0001.zkey private-transfer_final.zkey 0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f 10 -n='Obscura Final Beacon'
scripts.copy-artifacts: mkdir -p ../frontend/public/circuits && cp private-transfer_js/private-transfer.wasm ../frontend/public/circuits/private-transfer.wasm && cp private-transfer_final.zkey ../frontend/public/circuits/private-transfer_final.zkey && cp private-transfer_js/witness_calculator.js ../frontend/public/circuits/witness_calculator.js
scripts.verify-setup: snarkjs zkey verify private-transfer.r1cs ppot_0080_14.ptau private-transfer_final.zkey
scripts.build-all: npm run compile && npm run setup:ptau && npm run setup:ceremony && npm run setup:contribute && npm run setup:finalize && npm run generate-verifier && npm run copy-artifacts
